$allow: A file that must name a departed thing goes here as { path, reason }. Keep it short: a test asserting a name is absent can assert a synthetic one instead.

allow.reason: mirrors exclusion globs configured in the SonarCloud UI verbatim. The literal is the actionable datum — it is what an admin searches Administration -> Analysis Scope for — so prose would break the row's only job. The entry goes when the UI drops the stale glob.
